title: Empire of the Vampire
author: Jay Kristoff
summary: Gabriel de Leon, the last of a holy order of vampire hunters, tells a chronicler the story of his life. The sun has been gone for decades and the night belongs to vampires, so his story is one of war, faith and loss.
readIf: you want a bloody, grown-up vampire fantasy with a world-weary narrator telling his own story.
skipIf: you dislike graphic violence, or you want a short book with a lot of lightness.

pairings.reason: Also built around a vampire telling his life to a listener, though far more brooding and personal than martial.
A similarly hard, funny-bleak fantasy with scarred fighters and little interest in heroism.
A classic of vampires overrunning a community, with a much smaller scale and a slow creeping dread.
